summary: Amended the plan to route runDurations as a separate parameter through emitDerivedArtifacts, writeSidecar, emitAgentArtifacts, and buildSnapshot without mutating state.
Amended the plan so the PRD carrier preserves root dependencies plus userStories[].dependencies and userStories[].passes, with matching US-001 and acceptance-criteria coverage.
Amended the plan so US-004 replaces hardcoded Plan 04 artifact reads with configured output paths and adds override coverage in tests, acceptance criteria, and verification.
Updated the plan to walk .ralph/jobs/*/prd.json and .ralph/job-groups/*/*/prd.json, and added US-001 test coverage for grouped member PRDs appearing in prdsByTaskId.
Updated the dependency graph plan so story nodes use globally unique `${taskId}:${storyId}` ids and US-003 tests assert duplicate PRD story ids do not collapse.
Added the missing optional OverviewTask.priority field to the plan's type widening story and tied the scoring rubric, tests, scope, files, and acceptance criteria to the documented 0.5 fallback.

Reworded the snapshot freshness acceptance criterion to compare snapshot.recommendations against the recommendations array inside the wrapped recommendations file, and snapshot.dependencyGraph against the unwrapped graph file.
